items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: Walking after a meal is linked to a smaller rise in sugar, with the biggest difference seen in walks of 10 to 19 minutes. You walked after 3 of your scored meals, which is too few to see how it affects you yet.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: Eating dinner at 8 pm or later is linked to a rise in sugar, with dinners from 8-9 pm linked to a bigger rise than dinners before 6 pm. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it affects you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.3 hours, which is a good start, and some studies suggest that longer overnight fasts might be linked to better sugar control. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed sugar control by -0.03 points in one study, but more research is needed to understand this link.
